Package info.openrocket.core.simulation.listeners

Class AbstractSimulationListener

java.lang.Object
info.openrocket.core.simulation.listeners.AbstractSimulationListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
info.openrocket.core.simulation.listeners.SimulationComputationListener, info.openrocket.core.simulation.listeners.SimulationEventListener, SimulationListener, Cloneable
Direct Known Subclasses:
EnsembleRunListener, FlightControllerSimulatorListener, MotorBatchRunner.TrialListener
public class AbstractSimulationListener extends Object implements SimulationListener, info.openrocket.core.simulation.listeners.SimulationComputationListener, info.openrocket.core.simulation.listeners.SimulationEventListener, Cloneable
An abstract base class for implementing simulation listeners. This class implements all of the simulation listener interfaces using methods that have no effect on the simulation. The recommended way of implementing simulation listeners is to extend this class.

    • endSimulation

      public void endSimulation(SimulationStatus status, info.openrocket.core.simulation.exception.SimulationException exception)
      Description copied from interface: SimulationListener
      Called when ending a simulation. This is called either when the simulation ends normally (due to an end simulation event) or when a SimulationException is thrown.

      This method cannot throw a SimulationException, since the simulation is already being ended.

      Specified by:
      endSimulation in interface SimulationListener
      Parameters:
      status - the simulation status.
      exception - the exception that caused ending the simulation, or null if ending normally.

    • postStep

      public void postStep(SimulationStatus status) throws info.openrocket.core.simulation.exception.SimulationException
      Description copied from interface: SimulationListener
      Called immediately after a simulation step has been taken. This method is called whether the SimulationListener.preStep(SimulationStatus) aborted the step or not.

    • isSystemListener

      public boolean isSystemListener()
      Return whether this is a system listener. System listeners are used internally for various purposes by OpenRocket. User-written listeners should always return false.

      System listeners do not cause warnings to be added to the simulation results when they affect the simulation.

      This implementation of the method always returns false.

      Specified by:
      isSystemListener in interface SimulationListener
      Returns:
      whether this is a system listener
